load_config_from_pkg: load a config file from a Python package using ImportlibResourcesConfigSource and return a ConfigResult
check_config_availability: check if a Python package config source is available by verifying the presence of __init__.py
check_is_group: check if a config path represents a group (directory) within a Python package config source
check_is_config: check if a config path represents a config file within a Python package config source
list_config_entries: list all config files and groups under a given path in a Python package config source
